items.raw_excerpt: Mandya officials urge farmers to adopt short-duration, low-water crops amid monsoon deficit for better resilience and sustainability.
items.summary_en: Monsoon rains have been low in Mandya district, India. Local officials ask farmers to plant crops that grow fast and use little water. This should help farms stay safe during the dry season.

items.raw_excerpt: The Arruda dos Vinhos City Council, in the Lisbon district, has begun the final phase of supplementary works for the town’s outer bypass—an investment of €600,000—the mayor announced.
items.summary_en: The city council of Arruda dos Vinhos has started the last phase of road works outside the town. The project costs 600000 euros. A bypass lets cars drive around the town instead of through it.

items.raw_excerpt: A Catholic priest, who was born in China and now a U.S. citizen, has officially become a Taiwanese citizen after overcoming bureaucratic hurdles tied to his birthplace.

items.raw_excerpt: If you’ve yet to check out a natural wonder in Ontario this summer, this more than 40-metre-tall waterfall is likely calling your name. Here’s what to know about Kakabeka Falls.
items.summary_en: Kakabeka Falls is a waterfall in Ontario, Canada. It is over 40 metres tall and the second tallest in the province. It sits in a small rural village with about 100 people.

items.raw_excerpt: Vivió en el Triásico medio y perteneció a una especie de la que no se tenía registro en Sudamérica
items.summary_en: Researchers found fossils of a fish that lived more than 240 million years ago. It lived in the Middle Triassic period. This species had never been recorded in South America before.
